sloka: मन्ये पतितम् आर्याया हृदयम् प्रेक्ष्य सागरम् ।रावणस्य ऊरु वेगेन भुजाभ्याम् पीडितेन च ॥५-१३-९॥
transliteration: manye patitam āryāyā hṛdayam prekṣya sāgaram ।rāvaṇasya ūru vegena bhujābhyām pīḍitena ca ॥5-13-9॥

translations.english: "He thinks, on account of the high speed during the flight of Ravana under the pressure of his arms, the noble, largeeyed lady might have given up her life.
